personality_one_liner: Un accompagnement médical rassurant, très lisible et structuré, pensé spécifiquement pour le confort visuel et cognitif des seniors.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Avoid dense clustering to reduce cognitive load for seniors.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism completely. Seniors need solid, opaque surfaces with high contrast to distinguish elements clearly.

screens.name: Accueil
screens.purpose: A reassuring daily summary showing therapy compliance, next maintenance task, and a friendly welcome.

states.loading: Centered large spinner with text 'Chargement des données...'
states.empty: No tracking data yet. Show a soft illustration and a 'Commencer mon suivi' button.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard. 'Impossible de charger les données.' with a large 'Réessayer' button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Médical o2' logo/text. A hero card with a warm medical image (scrimmed) and reassuring text. Below: a large, high-contrast 'Statut de thérapie' card (e.g., hours slept), followed by a 'Rappel d'entretien' checklist item. Single column, md padding.

screens.name: Guides
screens.purpose: A structured library of large, easily tappable cards for machine usage, mask fitting, and maintenance tutorials.
screens.layout: Two sections: 'Utilisation' (PPC, Masques) and 'Entretien' (Quotidien, Hebdomadaire). Use a single-column list of large cards with a leading icon in a brandTertiary tinted container, title, and a clear chevron icon. Do not use 2-col grids; keep it 1-col for readability.

screens.name: Suivi
screens.purpose: A simple, highly legible log of daily CPAP usage hours and patient feeling (ressenti), without overwhelming raw data charts.

states.empty: Illustration of a calendar. 'Vous n'avez pas encore entré de suivi.' + 'Ajouter la nuit dernière' primary CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky primary CTA at the bottom to 'Ajouter ma nuit'. Above it, a vertical scrollable history list. Each row displays the date (large), hours used, and an emoji/icon for the feeling (Bien, Moyen, Fatigué). Avoid complex charts; use simple progress bars or text logs.

screens.name: Assistant
screens.purpose: An AI-powered conversational interface (Claude) to answer immediate patient questions about their equipment.

states.empty: Welcome message from the Assistant: 'Bonjour, je suis l'assistant Médical o2. Comment puis-je vous aider avec votre PPC aujourd'hui ?' with predefined question chips.

screens.layout: Standard chat interface but with significantly larger text bubbles. Input field sticky at the bottom with a prominent 'Envoyer' button. Use brandTertiary for user bubbles and surfaceSecondary for assistant bubbles.

hero_accueil.alt: A smiling doctor talking to a senior patient

cpap_mask.alt: A man wearing a breathing mask

instructions_to_main_agent: SENIOR ACCESSIBILITY IS THE PRIORITY: Override default typography choices by using `lg` (16px) as the default body text size and `xl` or `2xl` for headers. Never use text smaller than 14px (`base`).
MINIMUM TOUCH TARGETS: Ensure all buttons, list rows, and interactive elements have a minimum height of 56px (taller than standard 48px).
NO GLASSMORPHISM: Seniors often struggle with low-contrast blurs. Use solid `surfaceSecondary` with a subtle 1pt border (`border`) for card separation instead.

COLOR BAN ENFORCEMENT: Absolutely NO blue, navy, indigo, or purple. The entire app relies on a calming, medical Sage/Forest Green (`brandPrimary`: #2D6A4F) paired with warm bone-white surfaces to reduce eye strain.

IMAGE SCRIM MANDATORY: If overlaying text on the `hero_accueil` image, you MUST use a gradient scrim (transparent to #2C3631) that reaches at least 70% opacity at the bottom. Use `onSurfaceInverse` for the text.
LAYOUT SIMPLICITY: Keep all lists (Guides, Suivi) strictly single-column. Do not use 2-col wrap layouts. Horizontal scanning is harder for this demographic.
Avoid medical jargon. Use clear, plain French (e.g., 'Ajouter ma nuit' instead of 'Soumettre données').
Keep navigation to the 4 bottom tabs. Do not bury features in deep submenus.
